claim_ceiling: Synthetic composition contract only. A REVIEW_ONLY result is eligibility for independent owner review, not engineering approval, product certification, construction authorization, robot actuation authority, occupancy approval, or proof of physical performance.

owner_refs.responsibility: Owns the Highveld project-level design-to-panel-to-as-built composition and source-preserving industrial-twin context. The benchmark consumes Sol-Atlas owner references and does not create a second site, BIM, IFC, approval, or asset graph.

Owns design intent, engineering reasoning, semantic change impact, process semantics and the benign workcell integration pilot. The benchmark consumes change-impact and process-evidence dispositions; it does not create a second CAD, solver, requirement graph, or authority system.

Owns physical simulation, panel-cell/process experiments, robot/as-built inspection and repair loops, lot-readiness projections and physical-identity reconciliation. The benchmark consumes these results without becoming a controller, simulator, inventory system, metrology authority, or canonical asset database.

Owns cross-organization participant authority, material provenance, custody and manufacturing execution evidence. The benchmark consumes the exact source-owned receipt dispositions and never mints authority, inventory, custody, certification, or approval.
Provides interoperability and traceability context. This profile is not a claim of ISO conformity, NIST certification, or formal standards conformance.

cases.title: Complete synthetic design-to-as-built reference chain
preconditions: A single synthetic panel has exact design and component revision identities.
The IFC/IDS projection, geometry reference, process plan and material-lot references resolve to those exact revisions.
Tool/workcell capability, execution, independent metrology, installation and as-built references are present and current.
All owner-provided references state their own disposition and schema/profile revision.
cases.mutation: No adverse mutation; evaluate the complete reference trace as submitted.

cases.title: Panel design revision changes after process and inspection evidence
preconditions: The original design revision has process, inspection and installation references.
A downstream manufacturing package is bound to the original design digest.
cases.mutation: Substitute a newer design revision while retaining process and inspection references from the prior generation.

cases.title: IDS information pass with a conflicting as-built geometry observation
preconditions: Required IFC properties satisfy the declared IDS profile.
An independent survey observation reports a station or connection datum outside the declared geometric tolerance.
cases.mutation: Attempt to treat the IDS information pass as proof that physical geometry conforms.

cases.title: Lossy IFC or robot projection drops a critical datum or tolerance
preconditions: The source design includes a datum, tolerance or connection requirement used by a downstream manufacturing or robot task.
The transformation declares a lossy or unsupported semantic projection.
cases.mutation: Remove the critical datum/tolerance from the projected work package while leaving the source model unchanged.

cases.title: Supplier lot identity differs from the approved material requirement
preconditions: The work package requires an exact material grade and approved product/lot scope.
The supplier delivery or receiving record carries a different physical lot identity or grade.
cases.mutation: Substitute a same-named or same-family lot without an owner-qualified equivalence and approval reference.

cases.title: Material is delivered but custody or receiving acceptance is incomplete
preconditions: A dispatch or delivery assertion exists.
A required custody handoff, receiving inspection or acceptance disposition is missing.
cases.mutation: Treat the delivery event as proof that the exact material lot and quantity are accepted inventory.

cases.title: Work package has complete bill of materials but no current reservation
preconditions: The material lot and planned quantity are otherwise correctly identified.
No current owner-native reservation/availability evidence covers the exact site, quantity and execution window.
cases.mutation: Infer executable material readiness from the presence of a BOM and delivery event.

cases.title: Manufacturing process is named but cell capability is not qualified
preconditions: A process plan references a named manufacturing process.
The actual machine/tool/workcell capability evidence does not cover a required tolerance, material, size or process condition.
cases.mutation: Treat a process label or generic machine family as proof that the exact operation is executable.

cases.title: Robot tool-center-point calibration is stale after tool exchange
preconditions: A stationary manipulator and tool were previously qualified for a bounded task.
The tool was exchanged or repaired and the current calibration evidence is expired or bound to an older tool configuration.
cases.mutation: Reuse the previous capability receipt for the new tool/configuration generation.

cases.title: Robot reports task success but independent metrology is incomplete
preconditions: An execution record reports task completion.
The required independent measurement coverage is incomplete or its uncertainty is outside the acceptance decision limit.
cases.mutation: Promote the controller or robot self-report to final product acceptance.

cases.title: Installed component identity does not match the released article
preconditions: The released package references one exact component/article and revision.
The installed observation identifies a different article, variant or revision.
cases.mutation: Join the installed record to the released design by family name or nominal geometry rather than exact identity.

cases.title: Material substitution approval applies only to a superseded design revision
preconditions: A material substitution was approved for one exact design revision.
The current work package uses a later design revision with a changed requirement or interface.
cases.mutation: Reuse the old substitution approval for the new design without an applicability witness.

cases.title: Inspection instrument calibration is outside its valid interval
preconditions: A metrology observation is available.
The instrument calibration validity window does not cover the observation time or measurement context.
cases.mutation: Treat the measurement as current because the report file is present and its numeric value is plausible.

cases.title: Repair changes a connection but old commissioning evidence is reused
preconditions: An installed panel has passed a bounded commissioning campaign.
A repair replaces or changes a connection, fixing or service interface.
cases.mutation: Retain the previous as-built configuration identity and reuse all commissioning evidence without change-impact assessment.

cases.title: Material certification is revoked before installation decision
preconditions: A material certificate was valid at manufacturing time.
A qualified revocation record is available before the installation decision frontier.
cases.mutation: Use the historical certificate without evaluating revocation state at the decision time.

cases.title: Approval references correct component but signer lacks scoped authority
preconditions: An approval or review receipt references the exact panel and revision.
The purported signer lacks the required role, scope, delegation or current authority evidence.
cases.mutation: Treat a valid signature or authenticated identity as sufficient professional or statutory approval.

cases.title: Manufacturer source data has unknown rights or permitted use
preconditions: A source CAD, drawing or machine file is available.
Its rights or permitted use status is unknown.
cases.mutation: Redistribute or use the source payload in a public benchmark bundle solely because its digest is known.

cases.title: Two sensors share a common calibration or power dependency
preconditions: Two measurements are presented as independent corroboration of a critical condition.
The sources share a calibration chain, sensor controller, clock or power dependency.
cases.mutation: Count both observations as independent evidence without recording their shared dependency.

cases.title: Site reference frame changes after panel layout approval
preconditions: The panel layout and robot task are bound to an exact site/workcell coordinate frame.
A later survey changes the accepted reference frame or its uncertainty envelope.
cases.mutation: Continue using the previous layout and robot pose evidence without transforming and requalifying the affected relationships.

cases.title: Unknown fixture state or safety envelope before robot task
preconditions: A robot work package is otherwise complete.
The exact fixture state, guarded zone, local safety condition or localization validity is Unknown.
cases.mutation: Allow the robot task to proceed because the planner produced a collision-free trajectory.

cases.title: As-built model is generated from design instead of observed installation
preconditions: A design model and installation package exist.
No independent installation survey or direct observation is present.
cases.mutation: Copy the design geometry into an as-built record and represent it as measured reality.

cases.title: Rollback to prior design with changed calibration and new incident history
preconditions: An exact prior design generation is restored.
Relevant tooling calibration, site conditions or incident history changed after the original evidence was gathered.
cases.mutation: Assume restoring the old design digest automatically restores all previous evidence applicability.

cases.title: Defect and near-miss history is deleted during repair
preconditions: A defect or near-miss observation exists for the installed panel or workcell.
A repair or corrective action is proposed.
cases.mutation: Replace the prior event history with a clean post-repair status and omit the original negative evidence.

cases.title: Panel disassembly attempted without required temporary support or qualified tool
preconditions: A panel disassembly or replacement procedure is requested.
The required temporary support, access, tool identity or removal-force limit is missing or invalid.
cases.mutation: Treat geometric access or nominal tool compatibility as sufficient evidence that removal is safe and feasible.
